attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California Renter's Credit calculation (2025). Non-refundable credit for renters who meet AGI limits. Single/MFS: $60 (AGI limit $50,746). Joint/HOH: $120 (AGI limit $101,492). Must not own property and cannot be claimed as dependent. Source: CA FTB.

condition_details.condition_dsl: (job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "HOH") and result.agi <= result.ca_renter_credit_agi_limit_joint

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 10 brackets (1% to 13.3%) plus Mental Health Services Tax (1% surtax on income over $1M). Highest state tax rates in the nation. Per California Franchise Tax Board (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "California Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ca_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ca_mental_health_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ca_total_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Head of Household; Filing Status is MFJ or HOH
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" strcasecmp 0 eq result.filing_status "head_of_household" strcasecmp 0 eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CA tax for Single filers using progressive brackets (10 brackets: 1% to 13.3%)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /ca_agi xdef
ca_agi result.ca_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /ca_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ca_tax xdef
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_1_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_1_rate mul /ca_tax xdef
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_1_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_2_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_1_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_2_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_2_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_3_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_2_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_3_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_3_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_4_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_3_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_4_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_4_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_5_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_4_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_5_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_5_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_6_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_5_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_6_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_6_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_7_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_6_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_7_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_7_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_8_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_7_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_8_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_8_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_8_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_9_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_10_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
0.0 /ca_mh_tax xdef ca_taxable_income result.ca_mental_health_tax_threshold gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_mental_health_tax_threshold sub result.ca_mental_health_tax_rate mul /ca_mh_tax xdef } if
ca_tax /result.ca_state_tax xdef ca_mh_tax /result.ca_mental_health_tax xdef ca_tax ca_mh_tax add /result.ca_total_tax xdef ca_tax ca_mh_tax add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"California tax calculated (Single): Base tax: $" result.ca_state_tax cvs strconcat ", Mental Health Tax: $" strconcat result.ca_mental_health_tax cvs strconcat ", Total: $" strconcat result.ca_total_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates California AGI per Form 540 Schedule CA. California conforms to IRC as of Jan 1, 2025 (SB 711) but has major differences. Starting with federal AGI, applies CA-specific additions (foreign earned income exclusion, combat pay) and subtractions (Social Security, unemployment, state tax refunds, military retirement).

initial_action.action_postfix: "CALIFORNIA FORM 540 SCHEDULE CA - AGI Adjustments" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.ca_agi xdef 0 local@ ca_additions > 0 local@ ca_subtractions >

condition_details.condition_dsl: Any income item is type social_security
condition_details.condition_postfix: false local@ has_ss > { dup type income_type > income_type "social_security" streq if true local@ has_ss > endif } job.incomes forall has_ss

condition_details.condition_dsl: Any income item is type unemployment
condition_details.condition_postfix: false local@ has_unemp > { dup type income_type > income_type "unemployment" streq if true local@ has_unemp > endif } job.incomes forall has_unemp

condition_details.condition_dsl: Any income is pension from military
condition_details.condition_postfix: false local@ has_military_retirement > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq if dup description desc > desc "military" contains desc "uniformed services" contains or if true local@ has_military_retirement > endif endif } job.incomes forall has_military_retirement

action_details.action_comment: CA AGI with SS, unemployment, and military retirement; Apply all major CA subtractions from federal AGI
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ ss_total > { dup type income_type > income_type "social_security" streq if dup gross_amount ss_total f+ local@ ss_total > endif } job.incomes forall ss_total 0 f> if " Subtract Social Security: -$" ss_total cvs strconcat " (CA excludes SS benefits)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ca_agi ss_total f- /result.ca_agi xdef ca_subtractions ss_total f+ local@ ca_subtractions > endif 0 local@ unemp_total > { dup type income_type > income_type "unemployment" streq if dup gross_amount unemp_total f+ local@ unemp_total > endif } job.incomes forall unemp_total 0 f> if " Subtract Unemployment: -$" unemp_total cvs strconcat " (CA excludes unemployment)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ca_agi unemp_total f- /result.ca_agi xdef ca_subtractions unemp_total f+ local@ ca_subtractions > endif 0 local@ military_retirement > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq if dup description desc > desc "military" contains desc "uniformed services" contains or if dup gross_amount military_retirement f+ local@ military_retirement > endif endif } job.incomes forall military_retirement 0 f> if military_retirement result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount fmin local@ exclusion_amt > " Subtract Military Retirement: -$" exclusion_amt cvs strconcat " (CA allows $20k exclusion)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ca_agi exclusion_amt f- /result.ca_agi xdef ca_subtractions exclusion_amt f+ local@ ca_subtractions > endif " California AGI: $" result.ca_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 540 Schedule CA)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Total CA Subtractions: $" ca_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: CA AGI with SS and unemployment only; Apply SS and unemployment subtractions
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ ss_total > { dup type income_type > income_type "social_security" streq if dup gross_amount ss_total f+ local@ ss_total > endif } job.incomes forall ss_total 0 f> if " Subtract Social Security: -$" ss_total cvs strconcat " (CA excludes SS benefits)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ca_agi ss_total f- /result.ca_agi xdef ca_subtractions ss_total f+ local@ ca_subtractions > endif 0 local@ unemp_total > { dup type income_type > income_type "unemployment" streq if dup gross_amount unemp_total f+ local@ unemp_total > endif } job.incomes forall unemp_total 0 f> if " Subtract Unemployment: -$" unemp_total cvs strconcat " (CA excludes unemployment)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ca_agi unemp_total f- /result.ca_agi xdef ca_subtractions unemp_total f+ local@ ca_subtractions > endif " California AGI: $" result.ca_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 540 Schedule CA)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Total CA Subtractions: $" ca_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: CA AGI with SS and military retirement only; Apply SS and military retirement subtractions
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ ss_total > { dup type income_type > income_type "social_security" streq if dup gross_amount ss_total f+ local@ ss_total > endif } job.incomes forall ss_total 0 f> if " Subtract Social Security: -$" ss_total cvs strconcat " (CA excludes SS benefits)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ca_agi ss_total f- /result.ca_agi xdef ca_subtractions ss_total f+ local@ ca_subtractions > endif 0 local@ military_retirement > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq if dup description desc > desc "military" contains desc "uniformed services" contains or if dup gross_amount military_retirement f+ local@ military_retirement > endif endif } job.incomes forall military_retirement 0 f> if military_retirement result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount fmin local@ exclusion_amt > " Subtract Military Retirement: -$" exclusion_amt cvs strconcat " (CA allows $20k exclusion)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ca_agi exclusion_amt f- /result.ca_agi xdef ca_subtractions exclusion_amt f+ local@ ca_subtractions > endif " California AGI: $" result.ca_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 540 Schedule CA)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Total CA Subtractions: $" ca_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: CA AGI equals federal AGI; No CA-specific adjustments needed

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California military retirement exemption (2025). New $20,000 exemption with AGI limits: $125k single, $250k joint. SBP payments receive same treatment. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, CA FTB.

initial_action.action_dsl: Initialize CA military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "CA Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Single filer, AGI ≤ $125k; Single AND AGI ≤ $125,000
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "single" strcasecmp 0 eq result.agi result.ca_military_agi_limit_single le and

condition_details.condition_comment: Joint filer, AGI ≤ $250k; Married Filing Jointly AND AGI ≤ $250,000
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" strcasecmp 0 eq result.filing_status "head_of_household" strcasecmp 0 eq or result.agi result.ca_military_agi_limit_joint le and

action_details.action_comment: Apply CA $20,000 military retirement exemption (Single, AGI ≤ $125k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement exemption (Single): $" result.ca_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ca_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply CA $20,000 military retirement exemption (Joint, AGI ≤ $250k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement exemption (Joint/HOH): $" result.ca_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ca_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No CA military retirement exemption (AGI exceeds limit)
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.military_retirement_pay /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement: NO EXEMPTION (AGI exceeds limit). Retirement: $" result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Fully taxable" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No CA military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
